description.en: A branching early plant bearing small, deeply incised leaf units.
description.zh: 分枝早期植物带细小深裂叶单元。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Eophyllophyton bellum; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Eophyllophyton bellum 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Incipient laminated, irregularly divided leaves differ from naked shoots and lycophyte microphylls.
distinctness.zh: 初步片状且不规则深裂的叶区别于裸轴及石松类小型叶。

modeling_brief.en: Use shallow folded leaf fans on an open axis skeleton; do not turn them into modern fern pinnules.
modeling_brief.zh: 在疏开轴架上布置浅折叶扇，不做成现代蕨类羽片。

assets.uncertainty: Total plant habit is incompletely preserved; require a selected axis reconstruction.

sources.title: Structure of the Earliest Leaves: Adaptations to High Concentrations of Atmospheric CO2
sources.supports: Eophyllophyton small, deeply divided early leaves.

description.en: A slender fossil reproductive axis bears rounded recurved seed cupules.
description.zh: 细化石生殖轴带圆形回曲种子杯。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Caytonia, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Caytonia 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Cup-like enclosed seed units on lateral stalks differ from open peltasperm discs and compact conifer cones.
distinctness.zh: 侧柄杯状包种单元区别于开放盾籽盘和紧凑针叶树球果。

modeling_brief.en: Use a thin axis with compact cupped side bodies and clearly marked openings only where observed.
modeling_brief.zh: 用细轴和紧凑杯形侧体建形，仅在有观察依据处标出口部。
